about: A folder's single display name used across the path line, sibling menus, nested index rows, generated root contents and outline: the parent index entry's text when the parent index lists the folder (Markdown backslash escapes removed, trimmed); otherwise the leading level-1 heading of the folder's own index file when it has one; otherwise the folder name. input: { folderName, parentEntryText (string or null/omitted), indexText (string with '\n' line endings, or null/omitted) }. expected: display name string.

cases.name: parent index entry text wins over own index heading and folder name
parent entry text unescapes Markdown escapes and trims spaces
blank parent entry text falls back to own index leading heading
no parent entry falls back to own index heading after front matter and bom
no parent entry supports setext level-1 heading in own index
no parent entry ignores level-2 heading and falls back to folder name
no parent entry ignores paragraph before heading and falls back to folder name

input.indexText:
说明文字

cases.name: empty heading in own index falls back to folder name
missing parent entry and index falls back to folder name
